content.value: Write a C program to calculate the electricity bill. Input the number of units consumed, calculate the bill using slab rate (first 100 units: 5 Tk./unit; next 100: 7 Tk./unit; above 200: 10 Tk./unit), and apply a 10% surcharge if the bill > 1000 Tk. or a 5% discount if bill < 500 Tk., and display the total bill with units.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2024
